variant.name: receiver_shared_linear_frequency_drift
variant.state: one drift_hz_s per receiver, applied to observation time centered within each track while retaining the baseline per-track offsets
variant.sharing: shared across every track and channel for the same receiver and fitted capture; cross-capture sharing requires independent stable-path/epoch evidence
variant.frequency_scaling: none; drift is absolute baseband Hz per second
variant.constant_frequency_bias: excluded as structurally redundant with the baseline per-track offset columns

independent_constraint.required_contract: immutable receiver/sample-clock stability evidence with receiver and capture-interval binding
independent_constraint.required_validity: evidence covers every fitted capture interval; cross-capture sharing additionally proves stable physical-path and hardware-epoch identity
independent_constraint.required_bound: finite drift_hz_s bounds derived independently of DS7 position/reference and residual tuning

admission_gates.baseline_inputs: matched baseline inputs, candidate bank, orbit inputs, and residual/Jacobian export for the selected panel are sealed
admission_gates.structural_redundancy: candidate column is not in the span of baseline per-track offsets; constant receiver bias is permanently rejected by this gate
admission_gates.identity: each observation maps unambiguously to a receiver and capture interval; any cross-capture sharing has independent stable-path/epoch evidence
admission_gates.calibration: independent drift/stability evidence and digest are available and valid for every fitted interval
admission_gates.injection: recover zero and both independently bounded drift endpoints within max(0.05 Hz/s, 0.10 * interval_width_hz_s), with no position injection
admission_gates.identifiability: unregularized weighted design has full column rank and scaled condition number <= 1000; each clock column retains normalized residual norm >= 0.05 after projection on position and existing nuisance columns
admission_gates.constraint_removal: removing the calibration constraint does not change rank, move a clock state by more than 2 standard errors, or create a boundary solution
admission_gates.replay: zero-correction reproduces baseline predictions and residuals within 1e-9 relative and 1e-6 Hz absolute tolerance
admission_gates.held_group: same frozen parameters improve held-group location score; residual reduction alone does not pass

stop_conditions: clock column is rank deficient or has projected normalized norm below 0.05
clock estimate is prior-boundary or materially prior-controlled
clock state absorbs a position derivative
independent path/epoch calibration is absent or invalid
